components.gap: Complete (i) the 1971 Stability, the f.c.p., and Superstability article (Ann. Math. Logic 3, 271-362) presentation for the formula-property and stability material used by the NIP/dividing-line goal; (ii) the 2015 Guide to NIP Theories' named IP/NIP, shattering, examples and dividing-line comparisons with the exact supporting results, preserving its finiteness, parameter and saturation conventions; (iii) the 2012 course's named simple-theory/local-character development, examples and stable/simple/NIP relationships with proof dependencies. The route has only definitions and survey statements discharged by grouped citations (Shelah1971Stability, Simon2015, TentZiegler2012), with no reconstruction of any of the three presentations and no proofs.

Definitions of formula-level IP/NIP and theory-level NIP are present (def:p03-nip), but no shattering/type-count characterization is stated or proved. The chosen characterization (for example: phi is NIP iff for some n no n-element set is shattered, iff the number of phi-types over finite sets is polynomially bounded), with all quantifiers explicit, and its proof are owed.

No reconstruction of the actual 1971 Stability, the f.c.p., and Superstability presentation appears; the paper is only cited in grouped citations. The other two same-year Shelah papers (the ultrapower paper and the unstable-spectrum paper Shelah1971NonIsomorphicModels) are not distinguished from it anywhere on the route.
